listing.name: BIGLOGISTICS
listing.aiSummary: Adds massive logistics ships, including ten welded Atlases, an extremely wide Prometheus, and a normal Starliner.

description: Adds oversized logistics vessels such as a giant Atlas made of ten welded ships and a very wide Prometheus. Includes a standard Starliner with a fixed description and nerfed sensor range to prevent weird interactions.
